newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen "active, strong and normal".
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen "active, strong and normal".

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise when the market reopens after Friday's weekend and following Thursday's suspension of trading in the wake of clashes between kerb market traders and police, brokers said.
"The market will remain active, strong and normal. Share prices may move upward," broker Khurshid Alam said.
Brokers said blue chips in the engineering, cement and pharmaceutical sectors may be in demand.
The DSE all-share index closed 269.23 points or 2.73 percet down at 3,298.04 on Wednesday on turnover of 166.4 million taka.
